rationale: This is a motor-vehicle collision: the claimant's vehicle was rear-ended by another car, causing total vehicle damage and injury to the policyholder.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended at Route 9 (8:15 AM yesterday) by another vehicle traveling ~35 mph; vehicle is totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report; claimant's policy is active with $100k coverage and $750 deductible.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph; other driver did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
